Mumbai has started experiencing its first signs of winter, with the minimum temperature dipping to 18.9° Celsius, while the temperature rose slightly in the afternoon on Saturday (November 14, 2026).
While mornings remained relatively cool, afternoon temperatures were expected to hover around 29° Celsius before dropping to 22° Celsius at night.
According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), the Santacruz weather station forecasts a minimum temperature of 19° Celsius and a maximum of 33° Celsius.
From November 15 to 19, maximum temperatures are expected to remain around 33° Celsius before dipping slightly to 32° Celsius on November 20, marking warm afternoons.
Meanwhile, Mumbai’s Air Quality Index (AQI) has shown signs of improvement after Diwali. On Saturday (November 14), the city’s AQI stood at 127, placing it in the ‘moderate’ category. However, several regions in Mumbai have recorded higher air pollution levels, with Nava Nagar recording an AQI of 200, Deonar at 178, and BKC at 183.
